name: prompter
title: Prompter
description: Rewrite the selected text with a fixed set of LLM prompts: fix errors, shorten, lengthen, change tone, format for Slack.
author: ivorpad

commands.name: fix-errors
commands.title: Fix Errors
commands.description: Fix spelling, grammar and punctuation in the selected text.

commands.name: make-shorter
commands.title: Make Shorter
commands.description: Cut the selected text down without losing its points.

commands.name: make-longer
commands.title: Make Longer
commands.description: Expand the selected text with more detail.

commands.name: more-professional
commands.title: More Professional
commands.description: Rewrite the selected text in a professional register.

commands.name: more-casual
commands.title: More Casual
commands.description: Rewrite the selected text in a casual register.

commands.name: for-slack
commands.title: For Slack
commands.description: Reformat the selected text as a Slack message.

commands.name: select-model
commands.title: Select Model
commands.description: Pick the model from the list your provider exposes.

commands.name: prompts
commands.title: Prompts
commands.description: Browse, run, edit, add or delete prompts, and edit the shared rules.

preferences.name: provider
preferences.title: Provider
preferences.description: Which API the prompts are sent to. Pick Other for any OpenAI-compatible server and set its Base URL.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: API key for the selected provider.

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: Base URL
preferences.description: Overrides the provider default. Required for Other, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama.

preferences.name: output
preferences.title: Output
preferences.description: What to do with the rewritten text.

preferences.name: autoCopy
preferences.title: Preview
preferences.label: Copy the result to the clipboard as soon as it arrives
preferences.description: In Preview mode, the rewritten text is copied automatically; Enter still pastes it. Off means ⌘Enter copies.
